title: Step 4: unified_stream.py stream driver and scripts/reviews_stream.py (all arms on fakes)
description:
## Purpose

Step 4: `unified_stream.py` + `scripts/reviews_stream.py`, the streaming driver composed from existing `UnifiedFlywheel` helpers.

## Scope

- Seeded batch sizes 1-10. Per item: predict with the current frozen bundle, log for prequential scoring; with probability p (default 0.3, uniform, propensity recorded) the SME reviews and `record_label` stores label + comment.
- Cold start: Jev+S zero-shot until 30 reviewed labels.
- Few-shot list: once each class has `per_label+1` reviewed items, `plan_example_list_round`/`improve_example_list`; re-optimize every 30 new reviews (max 4).
- Triggers via `SteeringPolicy('steering-v1').evaluate` after each batch: refit through `_gate`; steering through `_steer` + `_cap_to_budget` (max 3 rounds per arm). Labels-only arm counts plain disagreements toward the steering trigger.
- Jev answers all of an item's questions plus the example list in ONE request; on a promoted question/list, top up only the last 150 reviewed items plus future items.
- Arms B, L, E, X (+ optional E at p=1.0); held-out checkpoints after 300 stream items and at end; spend bounds (`--max-new-requests`, circuit breaker).

## Definition of done

Fakes run all 4 arms end to end offline; outputs text-free; specs pass; `make test` and `make unified-flywheel-test UF_PYTHON=/Users/home/Projects/Jev-Flywheel/.venv312/bin/python UF_CORE=/Users/home/Projects/Decision-Flywheel/src` green; planted/Emotion/FOMC replays byte-identical on copies; clone clean.

## Caps

$0 (offline).
